body.statement: On every sequence of nonempty shells satisfying the uniform legal same-shell deformation property, \(\inf_{\widetilde\mu}\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_N(s_N)}\mathbb E_PL(\widetilde\mu,\mu(P))\to0\) if and only if \(Ns_N^2\to\infty\). Without that property, \(Ns_N^2\to\infty\) remains sufficient. In the regular special case \(s_N\ge s_0>0\), the available upper scales are \(N^{-1}\) for squared risk and \(N^{-1/2}\) for honest maximal half-width; the matching lower scales require the same deformation premise.
body.justification: The proposition states the operational phase transition at exactly the strength justified by the conditional converse and records the unconditional regular upper-rate reduction.
body.gap: Lei and Ross establish regular fixed-\(T\) consistency and asymptotic normality, but necessity under a vanishing observable relation margin follows only when legal same-shell lower experiments exist.
body.consumer: An analyst can translate the estimated relation margin into a transparent go or no-go criterion for asymptotically reliable imputation.
